content.title:
TheArtRevival on Instagram: "Are you surprised?

Banksy’s identity revealed! @banksy"
content.text: Are you surprised?Banksy’s identity revealed! @banksyImage if they put this much detective work into EpsteinI don't care what they found. I don't want to know. I don't want to see the name. It's how he intended his identity to BE and that's how respect goeaThis is like unmasking batman 👎If that tech is supposed to find dangerous criminals they could've used it to find a dangerous criminal as an example not "unmask" an artist. I just think they wanted to use Bansky as a warning to other artists who think of speaking out against them 🙌🏻As a Ukrainian I'm ashamed that our people just straight up doxxed a man that supported us. I hate those who did it, leave the guy aloneThey could’ve used that time and energy unmasking an actual criminalUm of course he's in his 50s he started his work publicly in the 90sCan they do any British who is in Epstein files then?If you live in Bristol for a while and pay attention then it becomes apparent that lots of people know who Banksy is. Any particularly determined person could figure it out with some time and talking to some of the right people. But most people dont because what would be the point? The magic is that there isn't some flawed regular (and also brilliant) human being to undermine the art itself. Trying to figure it out is a real sad sack move...I hate how people just assume the "public" collectively want the same thing all the time without ever actually consulting with the public.Suprised? No. Mind-blown that Reuters thought this was in the public's interest? Yes, unfortunately.This energy could be for missing children. Why do they want to know who Banksy is .... We don't want to knowMaking this video is the only way I knew this. You did the things you claim you wish they hadn't done. Genuinely, why did you do that?So we can find a passionate artist that longs to stay anonymous, but we can't find the missing people and the many criminals that harm them? Interesting.. And before anyone says that this was a "demonstration", why not use the same demonstration on a real case instead of on something that people didn't care to know about? Something that actually could've helped the world and united families? But I digress..I don't want to know who Banksy is
